hints.title: Decide from the end
hints.body: Compare the last characters of the two strings. If they match, nothing needs to happen to them. If they differ, what operations could fix the last character of `source`?

hints.title: Three subproblems
hints.body: After choosing an operation, the remaining work is the same problem on shorter prefixes. Define `distance[i][j]` as the minimum edits to turn the first `i` characters of `source` into the first `j` characters of `target`.

hints.title: The recurrence
hints.body: If the current characters match, `distance[i][j] = distance[i-1][j-1]`. Otherwise it is one plus the minimum of deleting (`distance[i-1][j]`), inserting (`distance[i][j-1]`), and replacing (`distance[i-1][j-1]`). The first row and column are 0, 1, 2, … because edits against an empty prefix are pure insertions or deletions.
